Why the people around you shape how you think about money.

Kevin explains what he says Aristotle and NASA both pointed to: you become like the five people you spend the most time with, listen to and watch.

He says you copy their speech, their thinking and even their body language without choosing to. Podcasts, audios and biographies of wealthy people, he adds, let you tap into that energy too.

Who are your five?

Knowledge is only power if you can remember it.

Kevin explains that the first training company he launched taught memory, because his own memory was terrible. He took the course, it helped him, and he saw a business in helping students and professionals.

His logic: knowledge only becomes power when it's used, and it can't be used unless you remember it.

What would change if you trained your memory?
